newsitem.title: USA: IMH Commercial prices IPO at $15/share.
newsitem.headline: IMH Commercial prices IPO at $15/share.

text.p: IMH Commercial Holdings Inc on Tuesday announced an intial public offering of 5.5 million shares priced at $15 per share.
PaineWebber Inc, Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc, EVEREN Securities Inc and Oppenheimer & Co Inc will be the underwriters, IMH said in a news release.
IMH, formerly Imperial Credit Commercial Holdings Inc, is a recently formed specialty commercial mortgage property finance company that will operate as a real estate investment trust.
